title: Universality of colimits of spaces
statement:
Use spaces, coherent diagrams, homotopy pullbacks and colimits from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Fix nested universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$ and write $\mathcal S$ for the infinity category of $\mathcal U$-small spaces. Let $J$ be a $\mathcal U$-small simplicial indexing set, $B$ a small space, $F:J\to\mathcal S_{/B}$ a coherent diagram of spaces over $B$, and $f:A\to B$ a map of small spaces. Pullback preserves its colimit: the canonical map
$$\operatorname{colim}_{j\in J}(A\times_B F(j))\longrightarrow A\times_B\operatorname{colim}_{j\in J}F(j)$$
is an equivalence. The colimit on the right is formed over $B$, and the comparison is a map over $A$. Equivalently, $f^*:\mathcal S_{/B}\to\mathcal S_{/A}$ preserves all $\mathcal U$-small colimits, including the empty colimit.
